properties.name: Silverfort - Denied MFA with risk indicators
properties.description: Identifies Silverfort incidents involving denied MFA requests accompanied by additional risk indicators, such as a new host or impossible travel. This behavior may indicate a user rejecting an unauthorized authentication attempt.
properties.query:
CommonSecurityLog
| where DeviceVendor has 'Silverfort'
| where DeviceProduct has 'Admin Console'
| where DeviceEventClassID == "NewIncident"
| where Message has "SuspiciousDeniedMfa"
| extend IncidentData = parse_json(replace('^""|""$', '', Message))
| extend IncidentKind = coalesce(tostring(IncidentData.data.kind), tostring(IncidentData.kind))
| extend IncidentId = tostring(coalesce(IncidentData.data.id, IncidentData.id))
| extend IncidentSummary = tostring(coalesce(IncidentData.data.summary, IncidentData.summary))
| extend UserName = coalesce(
    tostring(IncidentData.data.users[0].samAccountName),
    tostring(IncidentData.data.users[0].upn),
    tostring(IncidentData.data.users[0].displayName),
    tostring(IncidentData.users[0].displayName)
)
| extend SourceHost = coalesce(
    tostring(IncidentData.data.sources[0].displayName),
    tostring(IncidentData.sources[0].displayName)
)
| extend DestinationHost = coalesce(
    tostring(IncidentData.data.destinations[0].displayName),
    tostring(IncidentData.destinations[0].displayName)
)
